visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair in a black t-shirt sits indoors against white curtains. He looks directly at the camera, opens his mouth wide to exhale forcefully, and then attempts to scream, but only makes a faint sound before leaning forward and laughing heartily. (2) A woman with short dark hair and a black tank top sits on a beige sofa in a well-lit living room. She exhales deeply, her facial muscles tensing from the effort, then lets out a tiny squeak and falls backward while laughing. Yellow bananas are visible on a shelf in the background. (3) A woman with glasses wearing orange-patterned pajamas sits in a living room environment. She exhales audibly, attempts a silent scream that results in a funny facial expression, and then laughs as she looks toward the camera. (4) A young girl with straight bangs and a green checkered dress sits on a sofa. She giggles and looks off-camera as if listening to instructions, then prepares to participate in the challenge. (5) The woman from the third phase is now wearing a white facial sheet mask. She exhales loudly with her mouth in an 'O' shape, then leans down laughing while clutching her side. (6) A woman with long curly hair in orange-patterned pajamas sits at a wooden table indoors. She exhales deeply, makes a strained face while trying to produce a sound, and eventually bursts into loud laughter.
